workflow.name: OLEANDER Blender Professional FreeCAD Oblique Face Free Move

authority_chain.selector: SELECTOR::LOCAL_POS_X_FACE resolved from yaw-transformed world normal
authority_chain.kernel_route: TopoShape.replaceShape / BRepTools_ReShape with sew/fix normalization and shell-to-solid rebuild when required

bounded_scope: single selected yaw-oblique planar face receives one governed 3D translation vector containing both normal and tangent components
R001 80x50x10 mm yaw +30 degrees uses +2 mm outward normal component plus 3 mm transformed local-Y tangent and 4 mm world-Z tangent
R002 100x60x12 mm yaw -25 degrees uses -2 mm inward normal component plus 3 mm transformed local-Y tangent and 4 mm world-Z tangent
semantic local +X face selector is re-resolved across dimensional and yaw revision
target plus four adjacent faces are rebuilt through BRepTools_ReShape while opposite face is not replaced
both revisions remain valid one-solid six-face B-Rep results
edited volume is validated against source volume plus signed normal displacement multiplied by selected-face area
opposite face center and area remain unchanged
zero move, move magnitude greater than 20 mm, normal component greater than 8 mm, and selector miss all fail before accepted mutation
FCStd plus R001/R002 STEP persist move vector, signed normal component, selector and authority metadata
Blender creates two tessellated display-only derivatives and preserves source hash/selector/yaw/normal component/authority across .blend save/reopen
invalidation_rule: Invalidate if combined normal+tangent behavior is decomposed into mesh-only or whole-solid motion, semantic selector becomes raw topology index, volume/opposite-face/failure gates are removed, or source authority does not survive Blender readback.
authority_note: This receipt proves one bounded yaw-oblique planar direct face-drag style translation with simultaneous normal and tangent components. It does not prove full-3D-oriented/nonplanar general face move or P0-B PASS.
